Eye Pattern - Bioluminescent Flecks.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Bioluminescent Flecks
Tiny luminous specks scattered through the iris — natural bioluminescence creating a subtle sparkle in the eyes.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Bioluminescent Flecks.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Both irises are scattered with tiny faintly glowing flecks against the base iris color, like embers or sparks suspended within the eye. Apply bioluminescent fleck scatter to both irises using selected eye colors. Do not turn this into active power use.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
